newsitem.title: ESTONIA: FOREKSPANK Q1 PROFIT 28.99 MLN KROONS.
newsitem.headline: FOREKSPANK Q1 PROFIT 28.99 MLN KROONS.

text.p: Forekspank said on Thursday that its first quarter profit was 28.99 million kroons after net profit in March of 8.99 million kroons compared to February's 9.25 million kroons.
Total assets at the end of the first quarter were 1.73 billion kroons compared to 1.5 billion kroons in February, the bank said in a statement.
The loan portfolio was 796 million kroons compared to 696 million kroons last month.
Deposits were 1.079 billion kroons in March, compared to 977 million kroons in February, the bank added.
Forekspank equity was 147 million kroons at the end of the month and share capital was 41 million kroons, the bank added.
